description: Free (no credits): draw a clean 2D floor plan from a layout YOU write — read the user's description, or look at their hand sketch or brochure plan, and send every room as a rectangle in metres (or feet) plus doors and windows. Returns the drawn plan (areas and dimensions on it) at once, saved so the user can fine-tune it in Pixly's floor plan editor. If the layout has problems (overlapping rooms, a door between rooms that don't touch) you get exactly what to fix — fix it and call again. To change a plan, call again with its planId and the whole updated layout. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

kind.description: door = hinged door, doorway = open gap with no door, sliding = sliding/patio door.

side.description: Only for to = "outside": which wall of the room the entrance is on.

to.description: Another room id that shares a wall with it, or "outside".

planId.description: To CHANGE a plan you drew before: its planId from that result, with the whole updated layout. Omit for a new plan.

rooms.description: Every room as an axis-aligned rectangle. Neighbouring rooms must share the wall exactly (one's right edge = the other's left edge) and must not overlap. An L-shaped space = two rectangles joined by a doorway. Lay out a typical sensible plan when the user gives only rough sizes.

id.description: Your own short handle for the room ("kitchen", "bed1"); doors and windows refer to it.

name.description: Label on the plan when the type isn't enough ("Bedroom 2", "Master bedroom").

type.description: What the room is; sets its colour and default label.

x.description: Left edge. The plan's x runs to the right.

y.description: Top edge. The plan's y runs DOWN (the top of the drawing is 0).

title.description: Address or listing name for the plan's title block.

units.description: Units of every number below, and of the labels on the plan.

side.description: Which wall; it must be an outside wall (not shared with another room).

name: draw_floor_plan

status.description: pending | processing | completed | failed — anything not completed/failed is still running
